description: Work out the density (pounds per cubic foot) and the freight class of a US LTL shipment on the NMFC density scale with 13 steps, in force since 2025-07-19. Each line is one piece size: length x width x height x weight of one piece, and optionally x number of pieces. Up to 20 lines. A malformed line or unit gets an error, not a class.

lines.description: One line per piece size, as LxWxHxWEIGHT or LxWxHxWEIGHTxPIECES (4 or 5 values), for example 48x40x48x500 or 24x18x12x30x3. The separator inside a line is x, X, × or *. Separate lines with a new line, a semicolon, or a comma followed by the next line (48x40x48x500, 24x18x12x30x3). A decimal comma inside a value is read as a decimal point (47,5 is 47.5). At most 20 lines: put pieces of the same size on one line with a piece count.

size_unit.description: Unit of the sizes: in or cm (also inch, inches, centimeter(s), centimetre(s); any case). Default in.

weight_unit.description: Unit of the weights: lb or kg (also lbs, pound(s), kgs, kilogram(s); any case). Default lb.

name: freight_class
